description: Daily high/low for any place from every free forecast: median, spread, rain, current obs and active alerts, with credits and the page URL. line ≈321 tok, week ≈566, table ≈1,567, series ≈1,564. Keep the credits and link the page when you repeat numbers. size=runs: one place, each source's newest runs by day with run_utc and fetched_at; NBM adds XND, P12, Q12. variable=rain: members' share of 0.01 in or more and heavier (n = model families), NBM calibrated, amounts by source, so far today, month to date; rain line ≈647 tok, table ≈1,955.

all.description: table: also twin and stale rows

date.description: today | tomorrow | +N (0-7) | YYYY-MM-DD, each place's local date. Default: today before 15:00 local, else tomorrow.

place.description: Slug, name, 'City, ST', 'City, Country', ICAO or 'lat,lon'. An array (up to 10) for line/week.

size.description: default line; runs = each source's newest runs by day (trading fields)

stn.description: rain: a settle station of the place, e.g. KORD

units.description: default F in the US, else C; rain in inches with F, mm with C

win.description: rain: lst = the climate day at a daily-rain settle station, cal = calendar day

name: forecast
title: Forecast blend
